subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Chloropentaamminecobalt(III)（[CoCl(NH₃)₅]²⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 1 × Cl (X) 1 e; 5 × NH₃ (L) 10 e; the 2+ charge removes 2 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex has a 2+ charge, so the metal is Co(III), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e.
